title_en: 3DMedAgent: Unified Perception-to-Understanding for 3D Medical Analysis
title_zh: 3DMedAgent：面向三维医学分析的统一感知到理解框架

sentences.en: 3D CT analysis spans a continuum from low-level perception to high-level clinical understanding.
sentences.zh: 3D CT 分析涵盖了从低层感知到高层临床理解的连续范围。

sentences.en: Existing 3D-oriented analysis methods adopt either isolated task-specific modeling or task-agnostic end-to-end paradigms to produce one-hop outputs, impeding the systematic accumulation of perceptual evidence for downstream reasoning.
sentences.zh: 现有的 3D 定向分析方法要么采用相互隔离的、面向特定任务的建模，要么采用与任务无关的端到端范式来产生一步到位的结果，这阻碍了为下游推理系统性地累积感知证据。

sentences.en: In parallel, recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exhibit improved visual perception and can integrate visual and textual information effectively, yet their predominantly 2D-oriented designs fundamentally limit their ability to perceive and analysis volumetric medical data.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，近期的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）展现出更好的视觉感知能力，并且能够有效地融合视觉与文本信息，但它们以 2D 为主的设计从根本上限制了其感知和分析体量医学数据的能力。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we propose 3DMedAgent, an unified agent that enables 2D MLLMs to perform general 3D CT analysis without 3D-specific fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 为了弥合这一差距，我们提出 3DMedAgent，这是一个统一的智能体，能够使 2D MLLM 无需针对 3D 进行微调即可执行通用的 3D CT 分析。

sentences.en: 3DMedAgent coordinates heterogeneous visual and textual tools through a flexible MLLM agent, progressively decomposing complex 3D analysis into tractable subtasks that transition from global to regional views, from 3D volumes to informative 2D slices, and from visual evidence to structured textual representations.
sentences.zh: 3DMedAgent 通过一个灵活的 MLLM 智能体协调异构的视觉与文本工具，将复杂的 3D 分析逐步分解为易于处理的子任务，这些子任务从全局视图过渡到局部视图、从 3D 体数据过渡到信息丰富的 2D 切片、从视觉证据过渡到结构化的文本表示。

sentences.en: Central to this design, 3DMedAgent maintains a long-term structured memory that aggregates intermediate tool outputs and supports query-adaptive, evidence-driven multi-step reasoning.
sentences.zh: 这一设计的核心在于，3DMedAgent 维护一个长期的结构化记忆，用于聚合中间工具输出，并支持查询自适应的、由证据驱动的多步推理。

sentences.en: We further introduce the DeepChestVQA benchmark for evaluating unified perception-to-understanding capabilities in 3D thoracic imaging.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步引入了 DeepChestVQA 基准，用于评测 3D 胸部影像中统一的感知到理解能力。

sentences.en: Experiments across over 40 tasks demonstrate that 3DMedAgent consistently outperforms general, medical, and 3D-specific MLLMs, highlighting a scalable path toward general-purpose 3D clinical assistants.
sentences.zh: 在 40 多个任务上的实验表明，3DMedAgent 持续优于通用型、医学型以及 3D 专门型的 MLLM，凸显了通往通用 3D 临床助手这一目标的可扩展路径。

sentences.en: Code and data are available \href{https://github.com/jinlab-imvr/3DMedAgent}{here}.
sentences.zh: 代码和数据可在 https://github.com/jinlab-imvr/3DMedAgent 获取。

title_en: 3DPoV: Improving 3D understanding via Patch Ordering on Videos
title_zh: 3DPoV：通过视频中的图像块排序提升三维理解能力

sentences.en: Visual foundation models have achieved remarkable progress in scale and versatility, yet understanding the 3D world remains a fundamental challenge.
sentences.zh: 视觉基础模型在规模和通用性方面取得了显著进展，但理解 3D 世界仍然是一项根本性的挑战。

sentences.en: While 2D images contain cues about 3D structure that humans readily interpret, deep models often fail to exploit them, underperforming on tasks such as multiview semantic consistency--crucial for applications including robotics and autonomous driving.
sentences.zh: 尽管 2D 图像包含人类易于解读的 3D 结构线索，深度模型却常常无法利用这些线索，在多视角语义一致性等任务上表现不佳——而后者对于机器人技术和自动驾驶等应用至关重要。

sentences.en: We propose a self-supervised approach to enhance the 3D understanding of vision foundation models by (i) introducing a temporal nearest-neighbor consistency loss that finds corresponding points across video frames and enforces consistency between their nearest neighbors, (ii) incorporating reference-guided ordering that requires patch-level features to be not only expressive but also consistently aligned, and (iii) constructing a mixture of video datasets tailored to these objectives, thereby leveraging rich 3D information.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种自监督方法，通过以下方式增强视觉基础模型的 3D 理解能力：（i）引入时间近邻一致性损失，在视频帧之间寻找对应点并强制其近邻保持一致；（ii）引入参考引导的排序，要求补丁级特征不仅要具有表达能力，还要始终对齐；（iii）构建一个针对这些目标定制的混合视频数据集，从而充分利用丰富的 3D 信息。

sentences.en: Our method, 3DPoV, achieves state-of-the-art performance in keypoint matching under viewpoint variation, as well as in depth and surface normal estimation, and consistently improves a diverse set of backbones, including DINOv3.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法 3DPoV 在视角变化下的关键点匹配以及深度和表面法线估计方面达到了当前最优性能，并持续改进包括 DINOv3 在内的多种骨干网络。

title_en: 3ViewSense: Spatial and Mental Perspective Reasoning from Orthographic Views in Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 3ViewSense：视觉语言模型基于正投影视图的空间与心理视角推理

sentences.en: Current Large Language Models have achieved Olympiad-level logic, yet Vision-Language Models paradoxically falter on elementary spatial tasks like block counting.
sentences.zh: 当前的大语言模型已经达到了奥林匹克级别的逻辑能力，然而视觉语言模型却出人意料地在积木计数等基础空间任务上表现不佳。

sentences.en: This capability mismatch reveals a critical "spatial intelligence gap," where models fail to construct coherent 3D mental representations from 2D observations.
sentences.zh: 这种能力上的不匹配揭示了一个关键的“空间智能鸿沟”：模型无法从 2D 观测中构建连贯的 3D 心智表征。

sentences.en: We uncover this gap via diagnostic analyses showing the bottleneck is a missing view-consistent spatial interface rather than insufficient visual features or weak reasoning.
sentences.zh: 我们通过诊断分析揭示了这一鸿沟，表明瓶颈在于缺少视图一致的空间接口，而非视觉特征不足或推理能力薄弱。

sentences.en: To bridge this, we introduce **3ViewSense**, a framework that grounds spatial reasoning in Orthographic Views.
sentences.zh: 为弥补这一点，我们提出了 **3ViewSense**，一个将空间推理置于正投影视图（Orthographic Views）基础之上的框架。

sentences.en: Drawing on engineering cognition, we propose a "Simulate-and-Reason" mechanism that decomposes complex scenes into canonical orthographic projections to resolve geometric ambiguities.
sentences.zh: 借鉴工程认知，我们提出一种“模拟与推理”（Simulate-and-Reason）机制，将复杂场景分解为规范的正交投影，以消解几何歧义。

sentences.en: By aligning egocentric perceptions with these allocentric references, our method facilitates explicit mental rotation and reconstruction.
sentences.zh: 通过将自我中心的感知与这些异中心的参考对齐，我们的方法促进了显式的心理旋转与重建。

sentences.en: Empirical results on spatial reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing baselines, with consistent gains on occlusion-heavy counting and view-consistent spatial reasoning.
sentences.zh: 在空间推理基准上的实证结果表明，我们的方法显著优于现有基线，并在遮挡较重的计数和视图一致的空间推理上取得了一致的提升。

sentences.en: The framework also improves the stability and consistency of spatial descriptions, offering a scalable path toward stronger spatial intelligence in multimodal systems.
sentences.zh: 该框架还改善了空间描述的稳定性与一致性，为在多模态系统中迈向更强的空间智能提供了一条可扩展的路径。

title_en: 4DPC$^2$hat: Towards Dynamic Point Cloud Understanding with Failure-Aware Bootstrapping
title_zh: 4DPC$^2$hat：通过失效感知的自举学习迈向动态点云理解

sentences.en: Point clouds provide a compact and expressive representation of 3D objects, and have recently been integrated into multimodal large language models (MLLMs).
sentences.zh: 点云提供了 3D 对象的紧凑而富有表现力的表示，近年来已被集成到多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中。

sentences.en: However, existing methods primarily focus on static objects, while understanding dynamic point cloud sequences remains largely unexplored.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法主要关注静态对象，动态点云序列的理解在很大程度上仍未被探索。

sentences.en: This limitation is mainly caused by the lack of large-scale cross-modal datasets and the difficulty of modeling motions in spatio-temporal contexts.
sentences.zh: 这一局限主要由两个原因造成：缺乏大规模跨模态数据集，以及在时空上下文中建模运动的困难。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we present 4DPC$^2$hat, the *first* MLLM tailored for dynamic point cloud understanding.
sentences.zh: 为了弥合这一差距，我们提出 4DPC$^2$hat，这是首个专为动态点云理解而设计的 MLLM。

sentences.en: To this end, we construct a large-scale cross-modal dataset 4DPC$^2$hat-200K via a meticulous two-stage pipeline consisting of topology-consistent 4D point construction and two-level captioning.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们通过一个精心设计的两阶段流程构建了大规模跨模态数据集 4DPC$^2$hat-200K，该流程包括拓扑一致的 4D 点构建和两级描述生成。

sentences.en: The dataset contains over 44K dynamic object sequences, 700K point cloud frames, and 200K curated question–answer (QA) pairs, supporting inquiries about counting, temporal relationship, action, spatial relationship, and appearance.
sentences.zh: 该数据集包含超过 4.4 万条动态对象序列、70 万帧点云以及 20 万对经过筛选的问题-答案（QA）对，支持关于计数、时间关系、动作、空间关系和外观的提问。

sentences.en: At the core of the framework, we introduce a Mamba-enhanced temporal reasoning MLLM to capture long-range dependencies and dynamic patterns among a point cloud sequence.
sentences.zh: 在框架的核心，我们引入了 Mamba 增强的时间推理 MLLM，以捕捉点云序列中的长程依赖和动态模式。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we propose a *failure-aware* bootstrapping learning strategy that iteratively identifies model deficiencies and generates targeted QA supervision to continuously strengthen corresponding reasoning capabilities.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们提出一种失败感知的引导学习策略，该策略迭代地识别模型的不足并生成有针对性的 QA 监督，以持续加强相应的推理能力。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that our 4DPC$^2$hat significantly improves action understanding and temporal reasoning compared with existing models, establishing a strong foundation for 4D dynamic point cloud understanding.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，与现有模型相比，我们的 4DPC$^2$hat 显著提升了动作理解与时间推理能力，为 4D 动态点云理解奠定了坚实基础。

title_en: 4RC: 4D Reconstruction via Conditional Querying Anytime and Anywhere
title_zh: 4RC：通过随时随地的条件查询实现四维重建

sentences.en: We present 4RC, a unified feed-forward framework for 4D reconstruction from monocular videos.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 4RC，一个统一的、用于从单目视频进行 4D 重建的前馈框架。

sentences.en: Unlike existing methods that typically decouple motion from geometry or produce limited 4D attributes, such as sparse trajectories or two-view scene flow, 4RC learns a holistic 4D representation that jointly captures dense scene geometry and motion dynamics.
sentences.zh: 与现有方法（通常将运动与几何解耦，或只产生有限的 4D 属性，如稀疏轨迹或两视角场景流）不同，4RC 学习一种整体的 4D 表示，同时捕捉稠密的场景几何与运动动态。

sentences.en: At its core, 4RC introduces a novel encode-once, query-anywhere and anytime paradigm: a transformer backbone encodes the entire video into a compact spatio-temporal latent space, from which a conditional decoder can efficiently query 3D geometry and motion for any query frame at any target timestamp.
sentences.zh: 4RC 的核心是引入一种新颖的“一次编码、随地随时查询”范式：一个 Transformer 骨干网络将整个视频编码为紧凑的时空潜在空间，条件解码器可以从中为任意查询帧在任意目标时间戳高效地查询 3D 几何与运动。

sentences.en: To facilitate learning, we represent per-view 4D attributes in a minimally factorized form, decomposing them into base geometry and time-dependent relative motion.
sentences.zh: 为便于学习，我们以最小化因子分解的形式表示每视角的 4D 属性，将其分解为基础几何与随时间变化的相对运动。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that 4RC outperforms prior methods across a wide range of 4D reconstruction tasks.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，4RC 在广泛的 4D 重建任务上优于先前的方法。

title_en: [CLS] is Not Enough: Multi-Label Recognition via Patch-Level Inference and Adaptive Aggregation
title_zh: 仅有 [CLS] 还不够：通过图像块级推理与自适应聚合实现多标签识别

sentences.en: Vision-Language Models such as CLIP exhibit strong zero-shot recognition capability by aligning images with textual concepts, yet they often underperform on multi-label recognition where multiple objects co-exist.
sentences.zh: 像 CLIP 这样的视觉语言模型通过将图像与文本概念对齐展现出强大的零样本识别能力，但在多个对象共存的多标签识别中往往表现不佳。

sentences.en: A key bottleneck is that the CLS token, as a single global visual representation, is insufficient to faithfully encode diverse targets with varying scales, contexts, and co-occurrence patterns.
sentences.zh: 一个关键的瓶颈在于，作为单一全局视觉表示的 CLS 标记不足以忠实地编码尺度、上下文和共现模式各不相同的多样目标。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we present a new multi-label image recognition framework, termed **PIAA**, which formulates prediction as ***P**atch-level **I**nference followed by **A**daptive **A**ggregation*.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一局限，我们提出一个新的多标签图像识别框架，称为 **PIAA**，它将预测形式化为补丁级推理后接自适应聚合。

sentences.en: Specifically, we first enhance patch-wise predictions from two complementary perspectives: (i) mitigating semantic entanglement in the visual encoder to obtain more discriminative patch representations, and (ii) learning an unsupervised visual classifier to narrow the vision–language modality gap.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们首先从两个互补的角度增强逐补丁预测：（i）缓解视觉编码器中的语义纠缠，以获得更具判别力的补丁表示；（ii）学习一个无监督的视觉分类器，以缩小视觉与语言之间的模态差距。

sentences.en: We then introduce an adaptive aggregation module that consolidates patch-level scores into the final multi-label prediction.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们引入一个自适应聚合模块，将补丁级分数整合为最终的多标签预测。

sentences.en: Notably, the entire pipeline is fully *Training-free*, requiring no gradient updates or parameter fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，整个流程完全无需训练，不需要梯度更新，也不需要参数微调。

sentences.en: Experiments show that our method achieves strong improvements with minimal extra computation, exceeding a 6\% mAP gain on the challenging NUS-WIDE benchmark over representative baselines.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，我们的方法以极少的额外计算取得了显著提升，在具有挑战性的 NUS-WIDE 基准上，相比代表性基线实现了超过 6\% 的 mAP 提升。

authors.name: Huafeng Li
authors.institution: Kunmimg University of Science and Technology

title_en: ``Someone Hid It!'': Query-Agnostic Black-Box Attacks on LLM-Based Retrieval
title_zh: “有人把它藏起来了！”：针对基于大语言模型的检索系统的查询无关黑盒攻击

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) have been serving as effective backbones for retrieval systems, including Retrieval-Augmentation-Generation (RAG), Dense Information Retriever (IR), and Agent Memory Retrieval.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）已成为检索系统的有效骨干，包括检索增强生成（RAG）、稠密信息检索（IR）以及智能体记忆检索。

sentences.en: Recent studies have demonstrated that such LLM-based Retrieval (LLMR) is vulnerable to adversarial attacks, which manipulates documents by token-level injections and enables adversaries to either boost or diminish these documents in retrieval tasks.
sentences.zh: 近期研究表明，这种基于 LLM 的检索（LLMR）容易受到对抗性攻击，攻击者通过 token 级注入操纵文档，从而能够在检索任务中提升或压低这些文档。

sentences.en: However, existing attack studies mainly (1) presume a known query is given to the attacker, and (2) highly rely on access to the victim model's parameters or  interactions, which are hardly accessible in real-world scenarios, leading to limited validity.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的攻击研究主要存在两点局限：（1）假定查询对于攻击者而言是已知的；（2）高度依赖对受害模型参数或交互的访问，而这些在真实场景中几乎无法获得，导致有效性受限。

sentences.en: To further explore the secure risks of LLMR, we propose a practical black-box attack method that generates transferable injection tokens based on zero-shot surrogate LLMs without need of victim queries or victim models knowledge.
sentences.zh: 为了进一步探索 LLMR 的安全风险，我们提出一种实用的黑盒攻击方法，该方法基于零样本的替代 LLM 生成可迁移的注入 token，无需知道受害查询或受害模型的知识。

sentences.en: The effectiveness of our attack raises such a robustness issue that similar effects may arise from benign or unintended document edits in the real world.
sentences.zh: 我们攻击的有效性引发了一个稳健性问题：类似的效果也可能源于现实世界中良性的或非故意的文档编辑。

sentences.en: To achieve our attack, we first establish a theoretical framework of LLMR and empirically verify it.
sentences.zh: 为了实现我们的攻击，我们首先建立了 LLMR 的理论框架并对其进行实证验证。

sentences.en: Under the framework, we simulate the transferable attack as a min-max problem, and propose an adversarial learning mechanism that finds optimal adversarial tokens with learnable query samples.
sentences.zh: 在该框架下，我们将可迁移攻击建模为一个极小极大问题，并提出一种对抗学习机制，利用可学习的查询样本找到最优对抗 token。

sentences.en: Our attack is validated to be effective on benchmark datasets across popular LLM retrievers.
sentences.zh: 我们的攻击在流行 LLM 检索器的基准数据集上被验证是有效的。

title_en: A Bayesian Approach to Quantify the Uncertainty of Human Ratings in a Single-Instance Multimodal Framework
title_zh: 在单实例多模态框架中量化人类评分不确定性的贝叶斯方法

sentences.en: Human ratings are central to learning and inference across several application domains, but they are also subject to inter-rater biases and judgment errors.
sentences.zh: 在多个应用领域中，人类评分是学习与推理的核心，但它们也受到评分者间偏差和判断错误的影响。

sentences.en: Quantifying the uncertainty of these human ratings would require repeated measurements, which are expensive and rarely available at scale.
sentences.zh: 量化这些人类评分的不确定性需要重复测量，而这成本高昂且大规模情况下很少可用。

sentences.en: We propose a Bayesian graphical model to estimate the instance-level and item-level uncertainty of (subjective) human ratings by leveraging auxiliary (objective) data.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个贝叶斯图模型，通过利用辅助（客观）数据来估计（主观）人类评分的实例级和条目级不确定性。

sentences.en: Our model learns a shared latent content representation that explains factors common to both the human rating and auxiliary data and a latent uncertainty variable that captures fluctuations in the human assessments via a data-conditioned prior.
sentences.zh: 我们的模型学习一个共享的潜在内容表示，用以解释人类评分与辅助数据中共有的因素，并通过一个数据条件的先验学习一个潜在不确定性变量，以捕捉人类评估中的波动。

sentences.en: We develop a scalable amortized variational inference procedure that uses modality-appropriate neural encoders and decoders to represent the posterior factors.
sentences.zh: 我们开发了一种可扩展的摊销变分推断流程，该流程使用适应各模态的神经编码器和解码器来表示后验因子。

sentences.en: Experiments on synthetic data demonstrate that our framework can accurately recover the latent uncertainty under targeted ablations and stress tests.
sentences.zh: 在合成数据上的实验表明，我们的框架能够在目标消融和压力测试下准确恢复潜在的不确定性。

sentences.en: We further demonstrate our approach on a real-world dataset of paired functional MRI scans and behavioral testing for autism, thus highlighting the need for uncertainty quantification.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步在一个真实世界数据集上展示了我们的方法——配对的功能性 MRI 扫描与针对自闭症的行为测试数据，从而凸显了不确定性量化的必要性。

title_en: A Behavioural and Representational Evaluation of Goal-Directedness in Language Model Agents
title_zh: 从行为与表征层面评估语言模型智能体的目标导向性

sentences.en: Understanding an agent's goals helps explain and predict its behaviour, yet there is no established methodology for reliably attributing goals to agentic systems.
sentences.zh: 理解智能体的目标有助于解释和预测其行为，但目前尚无既定的方法论可以可靠地将目标归因于智能体系统。

sentences.en: We propose a framework for evaluating goal-directedness that integrates behavioural evaluation with interpretability-based analyses of models' internal representations.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个评估目标导向性的框架，该框架将行为学评估与基于可解释性的模型内部表征分析相结合。

sentences.en: As a case study, we examine an LLM agent navigating a 2D grid world toward a goal state.
sentences.zh: 作为案例研究，我们考察了一个在 2D 网格世界中向目标状态导航的 LLM 智能体。

sentences.en: Behaviourally, we evaluate the agent against optimal policies across varying grid sizes, obstacle densities, and goal structures, finding that performance scales with task difficulty while remaining robust to difficulty-preserving transformations and multi-goal structures.
sentences.zh: 在行为层面，我们在不同的网格尺寸、障碍密度和目标结构下将智能体与最优策略进行比较，发现其性能随任务难度提升而扩展，同时对保持难度的变换和多目标结构保持稳健。

sentences.en: We then use probing methods to decode internal representations of the environment and multi-step action plans.
sentences.zh: 然后，我们使用探测方法来解码环境与多步行动计划的内部表征。

sentences.en: We find that the LLM agent non-linearly encodes a coarse spatial map, preserving approximate task-relevant cues about its position and the goal location; that its actions are broadly consistent with these internal representations; and that reasoning reorganises them, shifting from spatial cues toward immediate action selection.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，LLM 智能体以非线性方式编码一张粗略的空间地图，保留关于其位置和目标位置的大致任务相关线索；其动作与这些内部表征大体一致；而推理会重组这些表征，从空间线索转向即时的行动选择。

sentences.en: Our findings support the view that introspective examination is required beyond behavioural evaluations to characterise how agents represent and pursue their objectives.
sentences.zh: 我们的研究结果支持这样一种观点：除行为学评估之外，还需要内省式的考察，才能刻画智能体如何表征和追求其目标。

title_en: A Benchmark and Framework for Evaluating Next Action Predictions in Spreadsheets
title_zh: 评估电子表格中下一步操作预测的基准与框架

sentences.en: Predictive code completion greatly accelerates how quickly developers work.
sentences.zh: 预测性代码补全极大地加速了开发者的工作效率。

sentences.en: In spreadsheets, despite being much more common, such auto-completion features are virtually non-existent.
sentences.zh: 在电子表格中，尽管这种自动补全功能更为常见，但实际上几乎不存在。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we introduce a benchmark for systems that observe a sequence of user actions in a spreadsheet and predict future actions.
sentences.zh: 为了弥补这一空白，我们引入一个基准，用于评估那些观察电子表格中用户动作序列并预测未来动作的系统。

sentences.en: Two challenges are (1) the absence of edit histories in public spreadsheet corpora and (2) the complex space of spreadsheet actions (spatial, temporal, composite).
sentences.zh: 这里有两项挑战：（1）公共电子表格语料库中缺乏编辑历史；（2）电子表格动作空间的复杂性（动作可分为空间、时间与复合类型）。

sentences.en: To address (1), we manually curate 52 sequences of 12K actions that recreate spreadsheets from public corpora, seeded by parametrized heuristics and LLM refinement.
sentences.zh: 针对（1），我们人工整理了 52 条动作序列（共 1.2 万个动作），这些序列由参数化启发式作为种子并通过 LLM 细化，重建了来自公共语料库的电子表格。

sentences.en: To address (2), we propose an online evaluation that expects a prediction after each user action, accepts or rejects that prediction, updates the future actions upon acceptance, and repeats this until the target spreadsheet is obtained.
sentences.zh: 针对（2），我们提出一种在线评估方式：在每个用户动作之后期待一个预测，接受或拒绝该预测，在接受时更新未来动作，并重复此过程，直到得到目标电子表格。

sentences.en: We use multiple baseline predictors (including zero-shot LLMs, fine-tuned SLMs, and classical models) and analyze different properties that our benchmark teaches us, including but not limited to: properties of saved actions and false positives, efficiency, effect of user profiles, effect of triggers, and effect of context.
sentences.zh: 我们使用多种基线预测器（包括零样本 LLM、微调的小语言模型和经典模型），并分析该基准带给我们的不同特性，包括但不限于：已保存动作与误报的特性、效率、用户档案的影响、触发条件的影响以及上下文的影响。

title_en: A Bi-metric Framework for Efficient Nearest Neighbor Search
title_zh: 用于高效最近邻搜索的双度量框架

sentences.en: We propose a new ``bi-metric'' framework for designing nearest neighbor data structures.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个新的“双度量”（bi-metric）框架，用于设计最近邻数据结构。

sentences.en: Our framework assumes two dissimilarity functions: a ground-truth metric that is accurate but expensive to compute, and a proxy metric that is cheaper but less accurate.
sentences.zh: 我们的框架假设存在两种不相似度函数：一种真实度量（ground-truth metric），精确但计算昂贵；另一种代理度量（proxy metric），更便宜但精度较低。

sentences.en: In both theory and practice, we show how to construct data structures using only the proxy metric such that the query procedure achieves the accuracy of the expensive metric, while only using a limited number of calls to both metrics.
sentences.zh: 无论在理论上还是实践中，我们都展示了如何仅使用代理度量来构建数据结构，使得查询流程能够达到昂贵度量的精度，同时仅对两种度量进行有限次数的调用。

sentences.en: Our theoretical results instantiate this framework for two popular nearest neighbor search algorithms: DiskANN and Cover Tree.
sentences.zh: 我们的理论结果将该框架实例化到两种流行的最近邻搜索算法上：DiskANN 和 Cover Tree。

sentences.en: In both cases we show that, as long as the proxy metric used to construct the data structure approximates the ground-truth metric up to a bounded factor, our data structure achieves arbitrarily good approximation guarantees with respect to the ground-truth metric.
sentences.zh: 在两种情况下我们都表明，只要用于构建数据结构的代理度量在有限因子范围内逼近真实度量，我们的数据结构就能相对于真实度量取得任意好的逼近保证。

sentences.en: On the empirical side, we apply the framework to the text retrieval problem with two dissimilarity functions evaluated by ML models with vastly different computational costs.
sentences.zh: 在实证方面，我们将该框架应用于文本检索问题，其中两种不相似度函数由计算成本差异巨大的 ML 模型来评估。

sentences.en: We observe that for almost all the large data sets in the BEIR benchmark, our approach achieves a considerably better accuracy-efficiency tradeoff than the alternatives, such as retrieve-then-rerank.
sentences.zh: 我们观察到，对于 BEIR 基准中的几乎全部大型数据集，我们的方法比检索后重排（retrieve-then-rerank）等替代方案实现了明显更好的精度-效率权衡。

title_en: A Call to Lagrangian Action: Learning Population Mechanics from Temporal Snapshots
title_zh: 呼唤拉格朗日作用量：从时间快照中学习群体力学

sentences.en: The population dynamics of molecules, cells, and organisms are governed by a number of unknown internal and external forces.
sentences.zh: 分子、细胞和生物体的群体动态由许多未知的内部和外部作用力所支配。

sentences.en: In the last decade, population dynamics have predominately been modeled with Wasserstein gradient flows.
sentences.zh: 在过去十年中，群体动态主要使用 Wasserstein 梯度流来建模。

sentences.en: However, since gradient flows minimize free energy, they fail to capture important dynamical properties, such as periodicity.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于梯度流最小化自由能，它们无法捕捉诸如周期性等重要动态特性。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose a change in perspective by considering population dynamics that minimize Wasserstein Lagrangian action, rather than free energy.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出一种视角的转变：考虑最小化 Wasserstein 拉格朗日作用（Lagrangian action）而非自由能的群体动态。

sentences.en: As our main theoretical contributions, we derive the Hamiltonian equations of motion from the principle of least population-level action and we show that these mechanics encompass classical mechanics, quantum mechanics, and gradient flows.
sentences.zh: 作为主要理论贡献，我们从最小群体级作用原理推导出哈密顿运动方程，并表明这些力学包含了经典力学、量子力学和梯度流。

sentences.en: We further leverage the Hamiltonian perspective to propose an algorithm that learns the population mechanics from observed marginals, without specifying the Lagrangian.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步利用哈密顿视角提出一种算法，能够在无需指定拉格朗日量的情况下，从观测到的边缘分布学习群体力学。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that by directly learning the population mechanics, our method forecasts and interpolates unseen marginals without a reference process, and outperforms gradient flow and flow matching methods across a wide range of real and simulated experiments.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，通过直接学习群体力学，我们的方法无需参考过程即可预测和插值未见过的边缘分布，并在广泛的真实和模拟实验中优于梯度流和流匹配方法。

title_en: A Capacity-Based Rationale for Multi-Head Attention
title_zh: 从容量角度解释多头注意力的合理性

sentences.en: We study the capacity of the self-attention key-query channel: for a fixed budget, how many distinct token-token relations can a single layer reliably encode?
sentences.zh: 我们研究自注意力键-查询通道的容量：在固定的预算下，单层能够可靠地编码多少种不同的 token 间关系？

sentences.en: We introduce *Relational Graph Recognition*, where the key-query channel encodes a directed graph and, given a context (a subset of the vertices), must recover the neighbors of each vertex in the context.
sentences.zh: 我们引入关系图识别（Relational Graph Recognition）任务：键-查询通道编码一个有向图，给定一个上下文（顶点的一个子集），必须恢复上下文中每个顶点的邻居。

sentences.en: We measure resources by the total key dimension $D_K = hd_k$.
sentences.zh: 我们以总键维度 $D_K = hd_k$ 来衡量资源。

sentences.en: In a tractable multi-head model, we prove matching information-theoretic lower bounds and upper bounds via explicit constructions showing that recovering a graph with $m'$ relations in $d_{\text{model}}$-dimensional embeddings requires $D_K$ to grow essentially as $m'/d_{\text{model}}$ up to logarithmic factors, and we obtain corresponding guarantees for scaled-softmax attention.
sentences.zh: 在一个易于处理的多头模型中，我们通过显式构造证明了匹配的信息论下界和上界：在 $d_{\text{model}}$ 维嵌入中恢复具有 $m'$ 种关系的图，本质上要求 $D_K$ 按 $m'/d_{\text{model}}$ 增长（直到对数因子），并且我们为缩放 softmax 注意力获得了相应的保证。

sentences.en: This analysis yields a new, capacity-based rationale for multi-head attention: even in permutation graphs, where **all queries attend to a single target**, splitting a fixed $D_K$ budget into multiple heads increases capacity by reducing interference from embedding superposition.
sentences.zh: 这一分析为多头注意力提供了新的、基于容量的合理性论证：即使在置换图中——所有查询都关注单一目标——将固定的 $D_K$ 预算分割为多个头，也会通过减少嵌入叠加带来的干扰而提升容量。

sentences.en: Controlled experiments mirror the theory, revealing sharp phase transitions at the predicted capacity, and the multi-head advantage persists when adding softmax normalization, value routing, and a full Transformer block trained with frozen GPT-2 embeddings.
sentences.zh: 受控实验与理论相吻合，在预测的容量处出现急剧的相变，并且多头优势在加入 softmax 归一化、值路由以及使用冻结的 GPT-2 嵌入训练的完整 Transformer 块之后依然存在。

authors.name: Micah Adler
authors.institution: Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Electrical Engineering & Computer Science

title_en: A Cartesian-3j Framework for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
title_zh: 用于机器学习原子间势的笛卡尔 3j 框架

sentences.en: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have brought substantial gains in the extrapolation capability in computational chemistry.
sentences.zh: 机器学习原子间势（MLIP）为计算化学中的外推能力带来了显著的提升。

sentences.en: However, most equivariant models are typically built with spherical tensors (STs), while Cartesian tensor formulations remain less developed despite their natural alignment with atomic coordinates and tensorial targets.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数等变模型通常使用球张量（ST）构建，而笛卡尔张量（Cartesian tensor）公式虽然与原子坐标和张量目标自然对齐，却发展得相对不足。

sentences.en: In this work, we develop a Cartesian framework for irreducible Cartesian tensors (ICTs) by introduce the Cartesian-3j symbol and Cartesian Generalized Clebsch-Gordan Coefficients, which serve as direct analogues of the Wigner-3j symbol and Generalized Clebsch-Gordan coefficients defined for ST coupling.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们通过引入 Cartesian-3j 符号和笛卡尔广义 Clebsch-Gordan 系数，为不可约笛卡尔张量（ICT）开发了一个笛卡尔框架，这两者分别对应于为 ST 耦合定义的 Wigner-3j 符号和广义 Clebsch-Gordan 系数的直接类比。

sentences.en: We extend the e3nn library to support ICT product, and use this framework to build Cartesian counterparts of MACE, NequIP, and Allegro, allowing the first controlled comparison where architectures are held fixed and only the tensor basis is changed.
sentences.zh: 我们扩展了 e3nn 库以支持 ICT 乘积，并使用该框架构建了 MACE、NequIP 和 Allegro 的笛卡尔对应版本，从而实现了首次受控对比——在这种对比中，架构保持不变，仅改变张量基。

sentences.en: Our experiments show that irreducible Cartesian models can achieve accuracy comparable to spherical counterparts, but direct Cartesianization incurs unfavorable compute and memory scaling, motivating dedicated Cartesian architectural choices.
sentences.zh: 我们的实验表明，不可约笛卡尔模型可以达到与球对应模型相当的精度，但直接笛卡尔化会带来不利的计算和内存开销，这促使我们需要专门设计笛卡尔架构。

sentences.en: Leveraging ICTs and our framework, we introduce TACE-v1-OAM-M and demonstrate that it achieves competitive performance on Matbench Discovery compared to state-of-the-art ST models.
sentences.zh: 利用 ICT 和我们的框架，我们引入了 TACE-v1-OAM-M，并证明它在 Matbench Discovery 上取得了与最先进的 ST 模型相当的竞争力。

title_en: A Causal Decomposition Approach for Fair Contextual Multi-Armed Bandits
title_zh: 用于公平上下文多臂老虎机的因果分解方法

sentences.en: Counterfactual reasoning is one of the fundamental facets of human cognition, involved in various tasks such as explanation, credit assignment, blame, and responsibility.
sentences.zh: 反事实推理是人类认知的基本方面之一，涉及解释、功劳分配、归咎和责任等各类任务。

sentences.en: It describes the queries what would have happened had some intervention been performed given that something else, corresponding to Layer 3 of the Pearl Causal Hierarchy.
sentences.zh: 它描述的是“如果在已经发生某事的情况下执行某种干预，将会发生什么”这类查询，对应于 Pearl 因果层级（Pearl Causal Hierarchy）的第 3 层。

sentences.en: In this project, we examine a specific type of counterfactual quantities, called counterfactual direct (Ctf-DE), indirect (Ctf-IE), and spurious (Ctf-SE) effects for quantifying fairness in a sequential decision-making framework.
sentences.zh: 在本项目中，我们研究一类特定的反事实量——反事实直接效应（Ctf-DE）、间接效应（Ctf-IE）和虚假效应（Ctf-SE）——用于在序贯决策框架中量化公平性。

sentences.en: Building on these measures, we formulate an online causally-fair learning problem with multiple long-term constraints and study it in both non-parametric contextual bandits and parametric logistic bandits settings.
sentences.zh: 在这些度量的基础上，我们构建了一个带有多个长期约束的在线因果公平学习问题，并在非参数情境式老虎机和参数逻辑回归老虎机两种设置下研究它。

sentences.en: We achieve sublinear regret and violations bounds for both bandits settings with roundwise counterfactual fairness constraints (that are a priori unknown) without Slater's condition.
sentences.zh: 在逐轮的（预先未知的）反事实公平约束下，无需 Slater 条件，我们在两种老虎机设置下都实现了次线性后悔界和违规界。

sentences.en: For logistic bandits, our method achieves $\mathcal{O}(1)$ per-round time complexity using an online mirror descent estimator, yielding an efficient algorithm.
sentences.zh: 对于逻辑回归老虎机，我们的方法使用在线镜像下降估计器实现了每轮 $\mathcal{O}(1)$ 的时间复杂度，产生了一种高效的算法。

title_en: A Close Look at Negative Label Guided Out-of-distribution Detection in Pre-trained Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 深入考察预训练视觉语言模型中负标签引导的分布外检测

sentences.en: Advances in pre-trained vision-language models have enabled zero-shot out-of-distribution (OOD) detection using only in-distribution (ID) labels.
sentences.zh: 预训练视觉语言模型的进展使仅使用分布内（ID）标签的零样本分布外（OOD）检测成为可能。

sentences.en: Recent methods in this direction expand the label space with negative labels to enhance the discrimination between ID and OOD inputs.
sentences.zh: 这一方向的近期方法通过扩展带有负标签的标签空间来增强 ID 与 OOD 输入之间的判别能力。

sentences.en: Despite their promising progress, there remains a limited understanding of their empirical effectiveness in open-world scenarios, where negative labels can arbitrarily diverge from real OOD ones.
sentences.zh: 尽管取得了有前景的进展，但在开放世界场景中，其经验有效性仍然缺乏深入理解——在这样的场景中，负标签可能与真实的 OOD 标签任意偏离。

sentences.en: This paper bridges this research gap with the helm of a novel energy-based framework, where the energy function is built upon the margin between the similarity of an input to ID labels and that to negative labels.
sentences.zh: 本文借助一种新颖的基于能量的框架弥合了这一研究空白，其中能量函数建立在输入与 ID 标签的相似度以及其与负标签的相似度之间的差值之上。

sentences.en: Guided by this framework, we prove that the inherent tolerance of such methods to the sampling bias essentially stems from estimating the worst-case energy function over a KL-constrained set of potential distributions centered on the negative label distribution.
sentences.zh: 在该框架的引导下，我们证明此类方法对采样偏差的内在容忍度，本质上源于在一个以负标签分布为中心、受 KL 约束的潜在分布集上估计最坏情况能量函数。

sentences.en: Furthermore, our theoretical analysis reveals that existing methods suffer from over-pessimism and consequently high sensitivity to outliers.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们的理论分析揭示，现有方法存在过度悲观的问题，并因此对离群值高度敏感。

sentences.en: Provably, we can alleviate these problems by leveraging Rényi divergence to refine potential distributions.
sentences.zh: 可证明地，我们可以通过利用 Rényi 散度来细化潜在分布，从而缓解这些问题。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments empirically manifest that our method establishes a new state-of-the-art across a variety of OOD detection settings.
sentences.zh: 大量实验从实证上表明，我们的方法在多种 OOD 检测设置中树立了新的当前最优水平。

title_en: A Coin Flip for Safety: LLM Judges Fail to Reliably Measure Adversarial Robustness
title_zh: 安全评估如同抛硬币：大语言模型评判器无法可靠衡量对抗鲁棒性

sentences.en: Automated ``LLM-as-a-Judge" frameworks have become the de facto standard for scalable evaluation across natural language processing.
sentences.zh: 自动化的“LLM 作为裁判”（LLM-as-a-Judge）框架已成为自然语言处理中可扩展评估的事实标准。

sentences.en: For instance, in safety evaluation, these judges are relied upon to evaluate harmfulness in order to benchmark the robustness of safety against adversarial attacks.
sentences.zh: 例如，在安全评估中，这类裁判被用来评估危害性，以便对标安全性在对抗攻击面前的稳健性。

sentences.en: However, we show that existing validation protocols fail to account for substantial distribution shifts inherent to red-teaming: diverse victim models exhibit distinct generation styles, attacks distort output patterns, and semantic ambiguity varies significantly across jailbreak scenarios.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们表明，现有的验证协议未能考虑红队测试（red-teaming）所固有的显著分布偏移：不同的受害模型展现出不同的生成风格、攻击会扭曲输出模式，并且不同越狱（jailbreak）场景中语义模糊性的差异也很大。

sentences.en: Through a comprehensive audit using 6642 human-verified labels, we reveal that the unpredictable interaction of these shifts often causes judge performance to degrade to near random chance.
sentences.zh: 通过使用 6642 个人工核验标签进行全面的审计，我们揭示了这些偏移之间不可预测的相互作用常常使裁判性能退化到接近随机猜测的水平。

sentences.en: This stands in stark contrast to the high human agreement reported in prior work.
sentences.zh: 这与先前工作中报告的高人类一致性形成鲜明对比。

sentences.en: Crucially, we find that many attacks inflate their success rates by exploiting judge insufficiencies rather than eliciting genuinely harmful content.
sentences.zh: 关键的是，我们发现许多攻击利用裁判自身的不足来夸大其成功率，而不是真正引出有害内容。

sentences.en: To enable more reliable evaluation, we propose ReliableBench, a benchmark of behaviors that remain more consistently judgeable, and JudgeStressTest, a dataset designed to expose judge failures.
sentences.zh: 为了实现更可靠的评估，我们提出了 ReliableBench（一个由更稳定可判定的行为组成的基准）和 JudgeStressTest（一个旨在暴露裁判失败的数据集）。

title_en: A Computational Framework for Evaluating Human-likeness in LLMs' Open-ended Human Behaviors
title_zh: 评估大语言模型开放式人类行为拟人程度的计算框架

sentences.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have found widespread application and research in scenarios such as role-playing and sociological simulations.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在角色扮演和社会学模拟等场景中已获得广泛的应用与研究。

sentences.en: Despite the growing use of LLM-based agents to simulate human activities, the extent to which their behaviors resemble human behavior remains underexplored.
sentences.zh: 尽管基于 LLM 的智能体越来越多地被用于模拟人类活动，但其行为与人类行为的相似程度仍未得到充分探索。

sentences.en: As diverse LLMs proliferate, the traditional Turing test is ineffective for scalable evaluation and prone to bias from human-crafted challenges, leading to unfair assessments.
sentences.zh: 随着各种 LLM 的涌现，传统的图灵测试对于可扩展评估已不再有效，并且容易受到人类设计挑战带来的偏差影响，从而导致不公平的评估。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose a novel distribution-based framework that comprehensively evaluates human-likeness and believability of AI behaviors by leveraging large-scale open-ended human behavior data from web.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出一个新颖的基于分布的框架，通过利用来自网络的大规模开放式人类行为数据，全面评估 AI 行为的拟人度和可信度。

sentences.en: For better evaluation, we design generic metrics to cover three principles: rationality, consistency, and diversity.
sentences.zh: 为了更好的评估，我们设计了通用度量以涵盖三项原则：合理性、一致性和多样性。

sentences.en: Implemented across online shopping, open-topic Q\&A, and urban mobility, our framework reveals that even the currently best LLM still exhibits a significant gap from real user behavior, underscoring the necessity of comprehensive research and evaluation of AI’s human-like capabilities.
sentences.zh: 该框架已在在线购物、开放话题问答和城市移动等场景中实现，结果显示，即使目前最好的 LLM 与真实用户行为仍存在显著差距，这凸显了对 AI 拟人能力进行全面研究与评估的必要性。

title_en: A Conflict-aware Evidential Framework for Reliable Sleep Stage Classification
title_zh: 用于可靠睡眠分期的冲突感知证据框架

sentences.en: Multi-view learning has been widely applied for sleep stage classification using multi-modal data.
sentences.zh: 多视图学习已被广泛应用于使用多模态数据进行睡眠分期分类。

sentences.en: However, existing methods typically assume that different modalities are well-aligned, which is often unattainable in real-world scenarios, thereby compromising the reliability of the staging results.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法通常假设不同模态之间对齐良好，这在真实场景中往往无法实现，从而损害了分期结果的可靠性。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose ConfSleepNet, a conflict-aware evidential framework that dynamically resolves inter-view conflicts.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 ConfSleepNet，一个动态解决视图间冲突的冲突感知证据框架。

sentences.en: The framework consists of multi-view evidence extraction and conflict-aware aggregation.
sentences.zh: 该框架由多视图证据提取和冲突感知聚合两部分组成。

sentences.en: In the first phase, it learns category-related evidence from different modalities, which represents the degree of support for individual sleep stages.
sentences.zh: 在第一阶段，它从不同模态中学习与类别相关的证据，这些证据表示对各个睡眠分期的支持程度。

sentences.en: Considering the inherent characteristics of varying modalities, we propose hybrid category structures for different modalities to promote more reasonable evidence learning.
sentences.zh: 考虑到不同模态的固有特征，我们针对不同模态提出混合类别结构，以促进更合理的证据学习。

sentences.en: In the second phase, view-specific opinions, including prediction results and uncertainty, are constructed from the learned evidence.
sentences.zh: 在第二阶段，从所学证据中构建视图特定的意见，包括预测结果和不确定性。

sentences.en: Notably, we propose a novel conflict-aware aggregation method that integrates these view-specific opinions into a reliable joint decision.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，我们提出一种新颖的冲突感知聚合方法，将这些视图特定意见整合成可靠的联合决策。

sentences.en: This mechanism can effectively resolve conflicts among opinions and synthesize them into a reliable joint decision.
sentences.zh: 该机制能够有效解决意见之间的冲突，并将其综合为可靠的联合决策。

sentences.en: Both theoretical analysis and experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of ConfSleepNet in sleep staging tasks.
sentences.zh: 理论分析和实验结果都证明了 ConfSleepNet 在睡眠分期任务中的有效性。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://github.com/By4te/ConfSleepNet_ICML2026/.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/By4te/ConfSleepNet_ICML2026/ 获取。

title_en: A Consensus Anchor-guided Hypergraph Framework for Incomplete Multi-view Clustering
title_zh: 用于不完整多视图聚类的共识锚点引导超图框架

sentences.en: Handling large-scale incomplete multi-view data poses a significant challenge in unsupervised representation learning.
sentences.zh: 处理大规模不完整的多视图数据是无监督表征学习中的一项重大挑战。

sentences.en: While anchor-based strategies have alleviated computational burdens, they typically rely on shallow bipartite graphs restricted to pairwise relations, failing to capture complex high-order correlations among samples.
sentences.zh: 虽然基于锚点的策略缓解了计算负担，但它们通常依赖局限于成对关系的浅层二部图，无法捕捉样本之间复杂的高阶相关性。

sentences.en: Furthermore, existing methods often treat observed and missing instances indiscriminately, ignoring the distributional shifts that lead to systematic bias in consensus anchor learning.
sentences.zh: 此外，现有方法往往不加区分地对待已观测和缺失的实例，忽略了导致共识锚学习出现系统性偏差的分布偏移。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework tailored for scalability and robustness, termed Hypergraph-Augmented Incomplete Multi-View Clustering (HA-IMVC).
sentences.zh: 为了解决这些局限，我们提出一个专为可扩展性和稳健性设计的新颖框架，称为超图增强的不完整多视图聚类（HA-IMVC）。

sentences.en: Unlike traditional approaches, HA-IMVC constructs a consensus anchor-guided hypergraph that explicitly models group-wise interactions, thereby preserving structural integrity even under high missing rates.
sentences.zh: 与传统方法不同，HA-IMVC 构建了一个显式建模组间交互的共识锚引导超图，从而即使在较高缺失率下也能保持结构完整性。

sentences.en: Crucially, we incorporate a dual-adaptive reweighting mechanism that calibrates importance at both the view and sample levels.
sentences.zh: 关键的是，我们引入了一个双自适应重加权机制，在视图级和样本级两个层面校准重要性。

sentences.en: This strategy adaptively penalizes severely incomplete samples to mitigate bias while harmonizing inconsistent views.
sentences.zh: 该策略自适应地对严重不完整的样本进行惩罚以减轻偏差，同时协调不一致的视图。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on diverse benchmarks demonstrate that HA-IMVC achieves superior clustering accuracy and maintains high efficiency, even in scenarios characterized by severe data incompleteness.
sentences.zh: 在多种基准上的大量实验表明，即使在数据严重不完整的场景中，HA-IMVC 也能取得优越的聚类精度并保持高效率。

title_en: A Constrained Optimization Perspective of Unrolled Transformers
title_zh: 从约束优化视角理解展开式 Transformer

sentences.en: We introduce a constrained optimization framework for training transformers that behave like optimization descent algorithms.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一个约束优化框架，用于训练行为类似于优化下降算法的 Transformer。

sentences.en: Specifically, we enforce layerwise descent constraints on the objective function and replace standard empirical risk minimization (ERM) with a primal-dual training scheme.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们在目标函数上施加逐层下降约束，并用原始-对偶训练方案替代标准经验风险最小化（ERM）。

sentences.en: This approach yields models whose intermediate representations decrease the loss monotonically in expectation across layers.
sentences.zh: 该方法产生的模型，其中间表示会在各层之间以期望形式单调地降低损失。

sentences.en: We apply our method to both unrolled transformer architectures and conventional pretrained transformers on tasks of video denoising and text classification.
sentences.zh: 我们将该方法应用于展开式 Transformer 架构和常规预训练 Transformer，任务包括视频去噪和文本分类。

sentences.en: Across these settings, we observe that constrained transformers achieve stronger robustness to perturbations and maintain higher out-of-distribution generalization, while preserving competitive in-distribution performance.
sentences.zh: 在这些设置中，我们观察到约束 Transformer 对扰动具有更强的稳健性，保持更高的分布外泛化能力，同时维持有竞争力的分布内性能。

title_en: A Control-Theoretic View of Mamba on Stability and Robustness
title_zh: 从控制理论视角理解 Mamba 的稳定性与鲁棒性

sentences.en: Selective State Space Models (SSMs) such as Mamba have emerged as efficient alternatives to Transformers, achieving linear complexity through input-dependent parameterization.
sentences.zh: 诸如 Mamba 之类的选择性状态空间模型（SSM）已成为 Transformer 的高效替代方案，通过依赖输入的参数化实现了线性复杂度。

sentences.en: However, this selectivity transforms the system from linear time-invariant (LTI) to linear parameter-varying (LPV), where individually stable matrices can produce unbounded trajectories under switching.
sentences.zh: 然而，这种选择性使系统从线性时不变（LTI）转变为线性参数变化（LPV），在这种情况下，即使各个矩阵单独稳定，在切换下也可能产生无界轨迹。

sentences.en: Existing work focuses on empirical performance, leaving global stability, robustness bounds, and practical certification unresolved.
sentences.zh: 现有工作侧重于经验性能，全局稳定性、稳健性界和实际认证仍未得到解决。

sentences.en: This paper develops a control-theoretic framework providing the first comprehensive stability and robustness analysis for selective SSMs.
sentences.zh: 本文开发了一个控制理论框架，为选择性 SSM 提供了首个全面的稳定性与稳健性分析。

sentences.en: We prove BIBO stability by viewing selective scans as continuous-time LTI sampling and establish two-term robustness bounds with linear growth in sequence length.
sentences.zh: 我们通过将选择性扫描视为连续时间 LTI 采样来证明 BIBO 稳定性，并建立了随序列长度线性增长的两项稳健性界。

sentences.en: For general LPV systems, we provide common quadratic Lyapunov function conditions and develop algorithms to extract certificate constants directly from trained weights.
sentences.zh: 对于一般的 LPV 系统，我们给出了公共二次李亚普诺夫函数的条件，并开发了直接从训练权重中提取证书常数的算法。

sentences.en: These results bridge control theory and SSM architectures, enabling formal guarantees for safety-critical deployment.
sentences.zh: 这些结果弥合了控制论与 SSM 架构之间的鸿沟，为安全关键部署提供了形式化保证。

title_en: A Critical Look at Targeted Instruction Selection: Disentangling What Matters (and What Doesn’t)
title_zh: 审视定向指令选择：厘清哪些因素重要、哪些不重要

sentences.en: Instruction fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) often involves selecting a subset of instruction training data from a large candidate pool, using a small query set from the target task.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的指令微调通常涉及使用来自目标任务的一个小型查询集，从大型候选池中选择一部分指令训练数据。

sentences.en: Despite growing interest, the literature on targeted instruction selection remains fragmented and opaque: methods vary widely in selection budgets, often omit zero-shot baselines, and frequently entangle the contributions of key components.
sentences.zh: 尽管兴趣日益增长，但关于目标指令选择的文献仍然零散且不透明：不同方法在选择预算上差异很大，常常省略零样本基线，并且经常将关键组件的贡献纠缠在一起。

sentences.en: As a result, practitioners lack actionable guidance on selecting instructions for their target tasks.
sentences.zh: 因此，从业者在为其目标任务选择指令时缺乏可操作的指导。

sentences.en: In this work, we aim to bring clarity to this landscape by disentangling and systematically analyzing the two core ingredients: data representation and selection algorithms.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们旨在厘清这一局面，通过解耦并系统分析两个核心要素：数据表示和选择算法。

sentences.en: Our framework enables controlled comparisons across models, tasks, and budgets.
sentences.zh: 我们的框架能够在模型、任务和预算之间实现受控对比。

sentences.en: We find that only gradient-based data representations choose subsets whose similarity to the query consistently predicts performance across datasets,models, and candidate pools.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，只有基于梯度的数据表示所选择的子集，其与查询的相似度才能跨数据集、模型和候选池一致地预测下游性能。

sentences.en: While no single method dominates, gradient-based representations paired with greedy round-robin selection often perform best on average at low budgets, but these gains diminish at larger budgets.
sentences.zh: 虽然没有任何单一方法全面占优，但基于梯度的表示配合贪心的轮询选择在低预算下常常平均表现最佳，不过这些优势在大预算下会减弱。

sentences.en: Finally, we unify several existing selection algorithms as forms of approximate distance minimization between the selected subset and the query set, and support this view with new generalization bounds.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们将若干现有选择算法统一为所选子集与查询集之间近似距离最小化的形式，并用新的泛化界支持这一观点。

sentences.en: More broadly, our findings provide critical insights and a foundation for more principled data selection in LLM fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 更广泛地说，我们的发现为 LLM 微调中更有原则的数据选择提供了重要见解和基础。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://github.com/dcml-lab/targeted-instruction-selection.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/dcml-lab/targeted-instruction-selection 获取。

title_en: A Decision-Theoretic View of Test-Time Training: When, How Far, and Which Directions to Adapt
title_zh: 从决策理论视角理解测试时训练：何时适应、适应多大幅度以及沿哪些方向适应

sentences.en: Test-time training (TTT) adapts a pretrained model to each prompt via parameter updates, improving accuracy under pretraining-to-test distribution shifts.
sentences.zh: 测试时训练（TTT）通过参数更新使预训练模型适应每个提示，从而提升在预训练到测试的分布偏移下的准确率。

sentences.en: Yet, its performance often suffers from instability and sensitivity to hyperparameters such as update steps and subspace.
sentences.zh: 然而，其性能常常受困于不稳定，以及对更新步数和子空间等超参数的敏感。

sentences.en: We explain this behavior through a decision-theoretic lens, treating TTT as implicit Bayesian inference in the kernel regime.
sentences.zh: 我们通过决策论的视角解释这一行为，将 TTT 视为核机制下的隐式贝叶斯推断。

sentences.en: Under a Gaussian process benchmark, we show that TTT reduces prediction error when updates are spectrally matched to the prompt's signal-to-noise ratio and aligned with query-relevant eigen-directions.
sentences.zh: 在高斯过程基准下，我们表明，当更新与提示的信噪比在谱上匹配，并与查询相关的特征方向对齐时，TTT 会降低预测误差。

sentences.en: This perspective underpins the following results: (1) we show when fixed update steps and subspaces fail under distribution shifts, motivating adaptive strategies; (2) we prove that selecting update steps via prompt evidence admits a PAC-Bayes guarantee against overfitting; and (3) we characterize the Bayes-optimal update subspace under a linear-Gaussian correction model, yielding a scoring rule for selecting Transformer blocks and heads.
sentences.zh: 这一视角支撑以下结果：（1）我们展示了固定更新步数和子空间在分布偏移下何时会失效，从而激发自适应策略；（2）我们证明通过提示证据选择更新步数可以在防止过拟合方面获得 PAC-Bayes 保证；（3）我们在线性高斯校正模型下刻画了贝叶斯最优的更新子空间，从而得出了一种用于选择 Transformer 块和头的评分规则。

sentences.en: Our theory helps explain the empirical instability of TTT, taking a step toward principled guidance for when, how far, and which directions to adapt.
sentences.zh: 我们的理论有助于解释 TTT 的经验性不稳定性，朝着为“何时适应、适应多远、向哪些方向适应”提供有原则的指导迈出了一步。

title_en: A Deep Learning Model of Mental Rotation Informed by Interactive VR Experiments
title_zh: 由交互式虚拟现实实验启发的心理旋转深度学习模型

sentences.en: Mental rotation—the ability to compare objects seen from different viewpoints—is a fundamental example of mental simulation and spatial world modeling in humans.
sentences.zh: 心理旋转——即比较从不同视角看到的物体的能力——是人类心理模拟与空间世界建模的一个基本范例。

sentences.en: Here we propose a mechanistic model of human mental rotation, leveraging recent advances in deep, equivariant, and neuro-symbolic learning.
sentences.zh: 在此，我们利用深度、等变和神经符号学习的最新进展，提出一个人体心理旋转的机制模型。

sentences.en: Our model consists of three stacked components: (1) an equivariant neural encoder, producing 3D spatial representations of objects from images, (2) a neuro-symbolic object encoder, deriving symbolic objects descriptions from these spatial representations, and (3) a neural decision agent, comparing these symbolic descriptions to prescribe rotation simulations in 3D latent space via a recurrent pathway.
sentences.zh: 我们的模型由三个堆叠组件构成：（1）等变神经编码器，从图像中产生物体的 3D 空间表示；（2）神经符号对象编码器，从这些空间表示中导出符号化的对象描述；（3）神经决策智能体，比较这些符号化描述，通过循环通路在 3D 潜在空间中指定旋转模拟。

sentences.en: Our model design is guided by the existing experimental literature on mental rotation, which we complemented with experiments in VR where participants could at times manipulate the objects to compare.
sentences.zh: 我们的模型设计以现有的心理旋转实验文献为引导，并辅之以 VR 实验加以补充，在 VR 实验中参与者有时可以操纵物体以进行比较。

sentences.en: Our model captures well the performance, response times and behavior of participants in our and others' experiments, and through ablation studies we demonstrate the necessity of each component.
sentences.zh: 我们的模型很好地捕捉了参与者在我们的和他人的实验中的表现、响应时间和行为，并通过消融研究证明了每个组件的必要性。

sentences.en: Our work adds to a recent collection of deep neural models of human spatial reasoning, further demonstrating the potency of integrating deep, equivariant, and symbolic representations to model the human mind.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作加入了最近一系列人类空间推理深度神经模型的行列，进一步证明了整合深度、等变和符号表示来建模人类心智的效力。

title_en: A Diagnostic Study of Multi-Agent LLMs for Real-World Debates
title_zh: 面向真实世界辩论的多智能体大语言模型诊断研究

sentences.en: Multi-agent LLM debates are increasingly used in domains such as policy, politics, and city planning, where ground truth is often unavailable.
sentences.zh: 多智能体 LLM 辩论越来越多地用于政策、政治和城市规划等领域，在这些领域中，真值往往不可得。

sentences.en: Yet existing evaluations rely heavily on outcome-based proxies such as consensus, majority vote, or LLM-as-judge scores, which can miss failures like sycophancy, domination, and premature convergence.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有评估高度依赖基于结果的代理指标，如共识、多数投票或 LLM 裁判得分，这些指标可能遗漏诸如奉承（sycophancy）、主导（domination）和过早收敛等失败模式。

sentences.en: We introduce a diagnostic framework that evaluates both debate outcomes and the deliberative process using interpretable metrics for engagement, responsiveness, influence asymmetry, balance, stability, and agent utility.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一个诊断框架，使用可解释的度量同时评估辩论结果和审议过程，涵盖参与度、响应性、影响不对称性、平衡性、稳定性以及智能体效用。

sentences.en: Across real-world debate settings and validation benchmarks, our process-level diagnostics align more closely with human judgments and reveal interaction failures that standard outcome-only measures overlook.
sentences.zh: 在真实世界的辩论设置和验证基准上，我们的过程级诊断与人类判断更为一致，并揭示了仅看结果的常规度量所忽视的交互失败。

sentences.en: These results show that reliable evaluation of multi-agent debates requires measuring not only what answer agents reach, but how they reach it.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，要可靠地评估多智能体辩论，不仅需要衡量智能体达成了什么答案，还要衡量它们是如何达成这一答案的。

title_en: A Diffusive Classification Loss for Learning Energy-based Generative Models
title_zh: 用于学习基于能量的生成模型的扩散式分类损失

sentences.en: Score-based generative models have recently achieved remarkable success.
sentences.zh: 基于评分的生成模型近来取得了显著成功。

sentences.en: While they are usually parameterized by the score, an alternative way is to use a series of time-dependent energy-based models (EBMs), where the score is obtained from the negative input-gradient of the energy.
sentences.zh: 虽然它们通常以评分来参数化，但另一种方式是使用一系列与时间相关的基于能量的模型（EBM），其中评分由能量的负输入梯度得到。

sentences.en: Crucially, EBMs can be leveraged not only for generation, but also for tasks such as compositional sampling or building Boltzmann Generators via Monte Carlo methods.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，EBM 不仅可以用于生成，还可以用于诸如组合采样或通过蒙特卡洛方法构建玻尔兹曼生成器（Boltzmann Generator）等任务。

sentences.en: However, training EBMs remains challenging.
sentences.zh: 然而，训练 EBM 仍然具有挑战性。

sentences.en: Direct maximum likelihood is computationally prohibitive due to the need for nested sampling, while score matching, though efficient, suffers from mode blindness.
sentences.zh: 直接最大似然估计由于需要嵌套采样而在计算上不可行，而评分匹配虽然高效，却存在模式盲（mode blindness）的问题。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we introduce the Diffusive Classification (DiffCLF) objective, a simple method that avoids blindness while remaining computationally efficient.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这些问题，我们引入扩散式分类（DiffCLF）目标，这是一种简单的方法，既避免了模式盲，又保持了计算效率。

sentences.en: DiffCLF reframes EBM learning as a supervised classification problem across noise levels, and can be seamlessly combined with standard score-based objectives.
sentences.zh: DiffCLF 将 EBM 学习重新构建为跨噪声水平的监督分类问题，并且可以与标准的基于评分的目标无缝结合。

sentences.en: We validate the effectiveness of DiffCLF by comparing the estimated energies against ground truth in analytical Gaussian mixture cases, and by applying the trained models to tasks such as model composition and Boltzmann Generator sampling.
sentences.zh: 我们通过在解析高斯混合情形下将估计能量与真值进行比较，并将训练好的模型应用于模型组合和玻尔兹曼生成器采样等任务，验证了 DiffCLF 的有效性。

sentences.en: Our results show that DiffCLF enables EBMs with higher fidelity and broader applicability than existing approaches.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，与现有方法相比，DiffCLF 使 EBM 具有更高的保真度和更广泛的适用性。

sentences.en: Our code is available at [h2o64/diffclf](https://github.com/h2o64/diffclf).
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 [h2o64/diffclf](https://github.com/h2o64/diffclf) 获取。

title_en: A Dirac-Frenkel-Onsager principle: Instantaneous residual minimization with gauge momentum for nonlinear parametrizations of PDE solutions
title_zh: Dirac–Frenkel–Onsager 原理：针对偏微分方程解的非线性参数化，利用规范动量进行瞬时残差最小化

sentences.en: Dirac-Frenkel instantaneous residual minimization evolves nonlinear parametrizations of PDE solutions in time, but ill-conditioning can render the parameter dynamics non-unique.
sentences.zh: Dirac-Frenkel 瞬时残差最小化会在时间上演化 PDE 解的非线性参数化，但病态条件可能使参数动力学不唯一。

sentences.en: We interpret this non-uniqueness as a gauge freedom: nullspace directions that leave the  time derivative unchanged can be used to select better-conditioned parameter velocities.
sentences.zh: 我们将这种非唯一性解释为一种规范（gauge）自由度：那些使时间导数保持不变的零空间方向，可以用来选择条件更好的参数速度。

sentences.en: Building on Onsager's minimum-dissipation principle, we introduce a history variable---interpretable as momentum---and inject it only along the nullspace directions.
sentences.zh: 基于 Onsager 的最小耗散原理，我们引入一个历史变量——可解释为动量——并且只沿零空间方向注入它。

sentences.en: The resulting Dirac-Frenkel-Onsager dynamics preserve instantaneous residual minimization, in contrast to standard regularization that can introduce bias, while promoting temporally smooth parameter evolution.
sentences.zh: 由此产生的 Dirac-Frenkel-Onsager 动力学保持了瞬时残差最小化，这与可能会引入偏差的标准正则化不同，同时还促进了时间上平滑的参数演化。

sentences.en: Examples demonstrate that the approach leads to increased robustness in singular and near-singular regimes.
sentences.zh: 示例表明，该方法在奇异和近奇异区域中带来了更强的稳健性。

title_en: A Direct Approach for Handling Contextual Bandits with Latent State Dynamics
title_zh: 处理具有潜在状态动态的上下文老虎机的直接方法

sentences.en: We consider a linear contextual bandit model where contexts and rewards are governed by a finite hidden Markov chain.
sentences.zh: 我们考虑一种线性情境式老虎机模型，其中情境和奖励由一条有限隐马尔可夫链支配。

sentences.en: We first revisit the simplified model by Nelson et al. (2022), in which rewards are linear functions of the posterior probabilities over the hidden states given the observed contexts (called beliefs), rather than functions of the hidden states themselves.
sentences.zh: 我们首先重新审视 Nelson 等人（2022）的简化模型，在该模型中，奖励是给定所观测情境的潜在状态后验概率（称为信念）的线性函数，而非潜在状态本身的函数。

sentences.en: This simplified model may be handled through a direct reduction to standard linear contextual bandits.
sentences.zh: 这个简化模型可以通过直接归约到标准线性情境式老虎机来处理。

sentences.en: We extend the theoretical analysis of this reduction to take into account the estimation of the parameters of the hidden Markov model [HMM] in the regret bound and to provide high-probability bounds not depending anymore on the reward functions and only depending on the model through the estimation of the HMM parameters.
sentences.zh: 我们扩展了这一归约的理论分析，以便在遗憾界中纳入隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）参数的估计，并提供不再依赖于奖励函数、且仅通过 HMM 参数估计与模型相关的高概率界。

sentences.en: Second, and most importantly, we instead study the more natural and more complex model incorporating direct dependencies in the hidden states (on top of dependencies on the observed contexts, as is natural for contextual bandits).
sentences.zh: 其次，也是最重要的，我们转而研究更自然也更复杂的模型，该模型在潜在状态之间引入了直接依赖（这与情境式老虎机中依赖观测情境一样自然）。

sentences.en: Under a classic HMM forgetting condition, the main algorithmic tool introduced to cope with the various statistical dependencies that the reward structure introduces is to only periodically update reward-model parameters.
sentences.zh: 在经典的 HMM 遗忘条件下，为应对奖励结构引入的各种统计依赖，我们所采用的主要算法工具是仅周期性地更新奖励模型参数。

title_en: A Direct Second-Order Method for Solving Two-Player Zero-Sum Games
title_zh: 求解双人零和博弈的直接二阶方法

sentences.en: We introduce, to our knowledge, the first direct second-order method for computing Nash equilibria in two-player zero-sum games.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，我们引入了第一个用于计算双人零和博弈纳什均衡的直接二阶方法。

sentences.en: To do so, we construct a Douglas-Rachford-style splitting formulation, which we then solve with a semi-smooth Newton (SSN) method.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们构造了一种 Douglas-Rachford 式分裂形式，然后用半光滑牛顿（SSN）方法进行求解。

sentences.en: We show that our algorithm enjoys local superlinear convergence.
sentences.zh: 我们证明我们的算法具有局部超线性收敛性。

sentences.en: To augment the fast local behavior of our SSN method with global efficiency guarantees, we develop a hybrid method that combines our SSN method with the state-of-the-art first-order method for game solving, Predictive Regret Matching (PRM$^+$).
sentences.zh: 为了给 SSN 方法的快速局部行为补充全局效率保证，我们开发了一种混合方法，将我们的 SSN 方法与目前最先进的博弈求解一阶方法——预测后悔匹配（PRM$^+$）——相结合。

sentences.en: Our hybrid algorithm leverages the global progress provided by PRM$^+$ while achieving a local superlinear convergence rate once it switches to SSN near a Nash equilibrium.
sentences.zh: 我们的混合算法利用 PRM$^+$ 提供的全局进展，同时在接近纳什均衡时切换到 SSN，从而获得局部超线性收敛速度。

sentences.en: Numerical experiments on matrix games demonstrate order-of-magnitude speedups over PRM$^+$ for high-precision solutions.
sentences.zh: 在矩阵博弈上的数值实验表明，对于高精度求解而言，本方法相比 PRM$^+$ 取得了数量级的加速。

title_en: A Distributional View for Visual Mechanistic Interpretability: KL-Minimal Soft-Constraint Principle
title_zh: 从分布视角理解视觉机制可解释性：KL 最小软约束原理

sentences.en: Most current paradigms in visual mechanistic interpretability (MI) remain confined to interpreting internal units of the vision model via heuristic methods (e.g., top-$K$ activation retrieval or optimization with regularization).
sentences.zh: 目前视觉机制可解释性（MI）的大多数范式仍然局限于通过启发式方法（例如 top-$K$ 激活检索或带正则化的优化）来解释视觉模型的内部单元。

sentences.en: In this work, we establish a theoretical distributional view for visual MI, which models the influence of a feature activation on the natural image distribution, thereby formulating a Kullback-Leibler (KL)-minimal optimization problem to model the MI task.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们为视觉 MI 建立了一个理论上的分布视角，该视角将特征激活对自然图像分布的影响建模，从而将 MI 任务形式化为一个 Kullback-Leibler（KL）最小化优化问题。

sentences.en: Under this framework, statistical biases are identified within previous MI paradigms, which reveal that they may either be perceptually uninterpretable to humans (i.e., deviate from the natural image distribution), or mechanistically unfaithful to the vision models (i.e., unable to activate model features).
sentences.zh: 在该框架下，我们识别出先前 MI 范式中的统计偏差，这些偏差表明它们要么对人类而言在感知上不可解释（即偏离自然图像分布），要么在机制上不忠实于视觉模型（即无法激活模型特征）。

sentences.en: To resolve the biases under the distributional view, we propose a model with a KL-minimal soft-constraint principle for visual MI that theoretically balances interpretability and faithfulness.
sentences.zh: 为了解决分布视角下这些偏差，我们提出一个采用 KL 最小软约束原理的视觉 MI 模型，该模型在理论上平衡了可解释性与忠实性。

sentences.en: We realize this principle via energy-guided diffusion posterior sampling.
sentences.zh: 我们通过能量引导的扩散后验采样来实现这一原理。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments validate the theoretical soundness of the proposed distributional view and demonstrate the practical effectiveness of our paradigm on the DINOv3 vision model.
sentences.zh: 大量实验验证了所提出的分布视角在理论上的合理性，并证明了我们的范式在 DINOv3 视觉模型上的实际有效性。

title_en: A Factorized Low-Rank RNN Framework for Uncovering Independent Neural Latent Dynamics and Connectivity
title_zh: 用于揭示独立神经潜在动态与连接结构的因子化低秩循环神经网络框架

sentences.en: Low-rank recurrent neural networks (lrRNNs) are a class of models that uncover low-dimensional latent dynamics underlying neural population activity.
sentences.zh: 低秩循环神经网络（lrRNN）是一类能够揭示神经群体活动背后低维潜在动力学的模型。

sentences.en: Although their functional connectivity is low-rank, it lacks independence interpretations, making it difficult to assign distinct computational roles to different latent dimensions.
sentences.zh: 尽管其功能连接是低秩的，但缺乏独立性解释，这使得难以将不同的计算角色分配给不同的潜在维度。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose the Factored Recurrent Neural Network (FacRNN), a generative lrRNN framework that assumes group-wise independence among latent dynamics while allowing flexible within-group entanglement.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一问题，我们提出分解循环神经网络（FacRNN），一个假设潜在动力学之间存在分组级独立性、同时允许组内灵活纠缠的生成式 lrRNN 框架。

sentences.en: These independent latent groups allow latent dynamics to evolve separately, but are internally rich for complex computation.
sentences.zh: 这些独立的潜在分组使得潜在动力学可以分离演化，同时内部又足够丰富以进行复杂计算。

sentences.en: We reformulate the lrRNN under a variational autoencoder (VAE) framework, enabling us to introduce a partial correlation penalty that encourages independence between groups of latent dimensions.
sentences.zh: 我们在变分自编码器（VAE）框架下重新表述 lrRNN，从而能够引入一个偏相关惩罚项，鼓励潜在维度各组之间的独立性。

sentences.en: Experiments on synthetic, monkey M1, and mouse voltage imaging data show that FacRNN consistently improves the disentanglement and interpretability of learned neural latent trajectories in low-dimensional space and low-rank connectivity over baseline lrRNNs that do not encourage group-wise independence.
sentences.zh: 在合成数据、猴 M1 和小鼠电压成像数据上的实验表明，与不鼓励分组级独立性的基线 lrRNN 相比，FacRNN 一致地提升了所学神经潜在轨迹在低维空间和低秩连接中的解纠缠性与可解释性。

title_en: A Fine-Grained Understanding of Uniform Convergence for Halfspaces
title_zh: 对半空间一致收敛的细粒度理解

sentences.en: We study the fine-grainded uniform convergence behavior of halfspaces beyond worst-case VC bounds.
sentences.zh: 我们研究超出最坏情况 VC 界的半空间一致收敛行为的细粒度特性。

sentences.en: For inhomogeneous halfspaces in $\mathbb{R}^d$ with $d\ge 2$, we show that standard first-order VC bounds are essentially tight: even consistent hypotheses can incur population error $\Theta(d\log(n/d)/n)$, and in the agnostic setting the deviation scales as $\sqrt{\tau\log(1/\tau)}$ at true error $\tau$.
sentences.zh: 对于 $\mathbb{R}^d$（$d\ge 2$）中的非齐次半空间，我们表明标准的一阶 VC 界本质上是紧的：即使是一致假设（consistent hypothesis）也可能产生 $\Theta(d\log(n/d)/n)$ 的群体误差，而在不可知（agnostic）设置下，当真误差为 $\tau$ 时，偏差按 $\sqrt{\tau\log(1/\tau)}$ 缩放。

sentences.en: In contrast, homogeneous halfspaces in $\mathbb{R}^2$ exhibit a markedly different behavior.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，$\mathbb{R}^2$ 中的齐次半空间表现出截然不同的行为。

sentences.en: In the realizable case, every hypothesis consistent with the sample has error $O(1/n)$.
sentences.zh: 在可实现情形下，每个与样本一致的假设都具有 $O(1/n)$ 的误差。

sentences.en: In the agnostic case, we prove a bandwise, log-free deviation bound on each dyadic risk band via a critical-wedge localization argument.
sentences.zh: 在不可知情形下，我们通过临界楔形局部化论证，证明了在每一个二进风险带上都有一个带状、无对数项的偏差界。

sentences.en: Unioning over bands incurs only a $\log\log n$ overhead, and we establish a matching lower bound showing this overhead is unavoidable.
sentences.zh: 对各带取并集仅产生 $\log\log n$ 的额外开销，并且我们建立了一个匹配的下界，表明该开销是不可避免的。

sentences.en: Together, these results give a fine-grained and nearly complete picture of uniform convergence for halfspaces, revealing sharp dimensional and structural thresholds.
sentences.zh: 综合来看，这些结果为半空间的一致收敛给出了细粒度且近乎完整的图景，揭示了尖锐的维度性和结构性阈值。

title_en: A Flat Vocabulary or a Rich Hierarchy? Re-introducing Intrinsic Structure Transforms the Autoregressive Image Generation
title_zh: 扁平词表还是丰富层次？重新引入内在结构改变自回归图像生成

sentences.en: Autoregressive (AR) models have shown great promise in image generation, yet they face a fundamental inefficiency stemming from their core component: a vast, unstructured vocabulary of visual tokens.
sentences.zh: 自回归（AR）模型在图像生成中展现出巨大的潜力，但它们面临着一个源自其核心组件的根本性低效问题：庞大且无结构的视觉 token 词汇表。

sentences.en: By treating tokens as a flat set, standard models overlook the manifold structure where geometric proximity reflects semantic similarity.
sentences.zh: 通过将 token 视为一个扁平集合，标准模型忽略了其中几何邻近反映语义相似性的流形结构。

sentences.en: This oversight unnecessarily complicates the prediction task, hindering training efficiency and limiting generation quality.
sentences.zh: 这种疏忽不必要地使预测任务复杂化，阻碍了训练效率并限制了生成质量。

sentences.en: To resolve this, we propose Manifold-Aligned Semantic Clustering (MASC), a principled framework that constructs a hierarchical semantic tree directly from the codebook's intrinsic geometry.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出流形对齐的语义聚类（MASC），一个直接从码本的内在几何构造层次语义树的原理性框架。

sentences.en: Utilizing a geometry-aware distance metric and density-driven agglomerative construction, MASC faithfully models the token embedding manifold.
sentences.zh: 利用几何感知的距离度量和密度驱动的凝聚式构建方法，MASC 忠实地对 token 嵌入流形进行建模。

sentences.en: By transforming the flat, high-dimensional prediction into a structured hierarchical task, MASC introduces a powerful inductive bias that simplifies learning.
sentences.zh: 通过将扁平的高维预测转化为结构化的层次任务，MASC 引入了一种简化学习的强大归纳偏置。

sentences.en: Designed as a plug-and-play module, MASC accelerates training by up to 71\% and significantly boosts generation quality, improving LlamaGen-XL's FID from 2.87 to 2.49. Crucially, MASC further serves as a convergence enabler for complex architectures.
sentences.zh: 作为一个即插即用模块，MASC 将训练加速最多达 71\%，并显著提升生成质量，将 LlamaGen-XL 的 FID 从 2.87 改善到 2.49。关键的是，MASC 还充当了复杂架构的收敛助推器。

sentences.en: These results establish that structuring the prediction space is as vital as architectural innovation, elevating existing AR frameworks to state-of-the-art performance.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，结构化预测空间与架构创新同等重要，将现有 AR 框架提升到了当前最优的性能水平。

title_en: A Formal Comparison Between Chain of Thought and Latent Thought
title_zh: 思维链与潜在思维的形式化比较

sentences.en: Chain of thought (CoT) elicits reasoning in large language models by explicitly generating intermediate tokens.
sentences.zh: 思维链（CoT）通过显式生成中间 token 来激发大语言模型中的推理。

sentences.en: In contrast, latent thought reasoning operates directly in the continuous latent space, enabling computation beyond discrete linguistic representations.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，潜在思维推理直接在连续潜在空间中运行，能够进行超出离散语言表示的计算。

sentences.en: While both approaches exploit iterative computation, their comparative capabilities remain underexplored.
sentences.zh: 尽管两种方法都利用了迭代计算，但它们各自能力的差异仍未得到充分探索。

sentences.en: In this work, we present a formal analysis showing that latent thought admits efficient parallel computation, in contrast to the inherently sequential nature of CoT.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们给出了一个形式化分析，表明与 CoT 固有的串行特性相反，潜在思维支持高效的并行计算。

sentences.en: Conversely, CoT enables approximate counting through stochastic decoding.
sentences.zh: 反过来，CoT 则能够通过随机解码实现近似计数。

sentences.en: These separations suggest the tasks for which depth-driven recursion is more suitable, thereby offering practical guidance for choosing between reasoning paradigms.
sentences.zh: 这些区分表明何种任务更适合深度驱动的递归，从而为在推理范式之间做出选择提供了实用指导。

title_en: A Fourier perspective on the learning dynamics of neural networks: from sample complexities to mechanistic insights
title_zh: 从傅里叶视角理解神经网络的学习动态：从样本复杂度到机制洞见

sentences.en: Neural networks trained with gradient-based methods exhibit a strong simplicity bias: they learn simpler statistical features of their data before moving to more complex features.
sentences.zh: 使用基于梯度的方法训练的神经网络表现出强烈的简单性偏差：在转向更复杂的特征之前，它们先学习数据中更简单的统计特征。

sentences.en: Previous analyses of this phenomenon have largely focused on settings with (quasi-)isotropic inputs.
sentences.zh: 先前对这一现象的分析主要集中于（准）各向同性输入的设置。

sentences.en: In this work, we study the simplicity bias from a Fourier perspective, which allows us to include two key features of natural images in the analysis: approximate translation-invariance and power-law spectra.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们从傅里叶视角研究简单性偏差，这使我们能够将自然图像的两个关键特征纳入分析：近似平移不变性和幂律谱。

sentences.en: We first show experimentally that simple neural networks trained on image classification tasks first rely on amplitude information $-$ related to pair-wise correlations between pixels $-$ before exploiting phase information, which encodes edges and higher-order correlations.
sentences.zh: 我们首先通过实验表明，在图像分类任务上训练的简单神经网络首先依赖幅度信息（即与像素间成对相关性相关的信息）——然后才利用相位信息，而相位信息编码了边缘和高阶相关性。

sentences.en: In view of this, we introduce a synthetic data model for translation-invariant inputs that allows precise control over amplitudes and phases while remaining tractable.
sentences.zh: 有鉴于此，我们引入一个针对平移不变输入的合成数据模型，该模型可以在保持可处理的同时精确控制幅度和相位。

sentences.en: We rigorously establish that for isotropic and high-dimensional inputs, classification based on phase information alone is a genuinely hard task: online stochastic gradient descent (SGD) cannot distinguish the structured inputs from noise within $n \ll N^3$ steps, but needs at least $n \gg N^3 \log^2{N}$ steps.
sentences.zh: 我们严格证明，对于各向同性和高维输入，仅基于相位信息的分类是一个真正困难的任务：在线随机梯度下降（SGD）在 $n \ll N^3$ 步内无法将结构化输入与噪声区分开，但至少需要 $n \gg N^3 \log^2{N}$ 步。

sentences.en: In contrast, we show both experimentally and theoretically that power-law spectra can dramatically accelerate the speed of learning phase information, even if the spectra do not help with classification.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，我们在实验上和理论上都表明，幂律谱可以极大地加速相位信息的学习速度，即使这些谱对分类没有帮助。

sentences.en: Simulations with two-layer networks trained on textures and with deep convolutional networks on ImageNet and CIFAR100 confirm this non-trivial interaction between amplitudes and phases, providing mechanistic insights into how deep neural networks can learn natural image distributions efficiently.
sentences.zh: 使用在纹理上训练的双层网络以及在 ImageNet 和 CIFAR100 上训练的深度卷积网络进行的模拟，证实了幅度与相位之间这种非平凡的相互作用，为深度神经网络如何高效学习自然图像分布提供了机制层面的洞见。
